items.body: - Fixed running `/compact` again, or after a command such as `/context`, summarizing away a message that Claude had not answered yet - Fixed a memory spike at the next prompt after Claude changed a very large file - Fixed Edit and Bash running out of memory on certain `/proc` files, and Edit hanging or running out of memory on devices and named pipes - Fixed Claude Code failing to start, or to clear stored credentials at sign-out, when saving its configuration file failed with "Out of memory"
